payload.title: Standalone frick-server binary + Docker image (unblocks frick deploy)
payload.description: The cutover left frick-server as a library-only crate with no standalone binary, so there was no way to run the server outside tests and `frick deploy image` defaulted to ops/deploy/server.Dockerfile which was deleted. Adding a frick-server binary (env config + FRICK_SCHEMA_PATH schema loader, else foundation; graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM) + a multi-stage ops/deploy/server.Dockerfile that the compose files + frick deploy expect. In progress via the fix-cutover-bugs workflow.
